Still local WebEyeTrack prototype

WebEyeTrack code and BlazeGaze model/weights are retained from the MIT-licensed
RedForestAI/WebEyeTrack repository at revision
75fbd2f5f784f2eb3a39675a8dcbf1b01c697f1c (js package metadata 0.0.2).
Copyright (c) 2025 Eduardo Davalos, Yike Zhang, Amanda Goodwin, Gautam Biswas.
See WebEyeTrack-MIT.txt. No separate model license is present in that snapshot;
the repository's MIT grant and notices are retained with its model files.
Source: https://github.com/RedForestAI/WebEyeTrack

Local modifications (see workspace vendor/webeyetrack/LOCAL-ADAPTATIONS.patch):
local model URLs; CPU FaceLandmarker with close(); explicit batch personalization,
no global-click labels, SVD affine solve, estimator-only gradients, bounded
in-memory raw support, optimizer/tensor/model disposal and intrinsics flag fix.
Explicit export/restore of only the six adapted estimator tensors, affine transform
and face-width normalization; fresh filters and reconstructed camera matrices on
restore. The app saves only that minimum learned state plus geometry locally;
raw observations and calibration/validation samples are never persisted.
Bilateral EAR hysteresis exposes open/closed/unknown separately from finite face
presence. Unknown/closed eye observations skip gaze inference and never become
labels or reference-check scores; missing faces cannot become blink events.
The page's owned worker/client/camera replace the upstream minimal proxy/webcam
lifecycle; preprocessing, metric head features and BlazeGaze architecture remain.

MediaPipe Tasks Vision 0.10.18 and its WASM runtime: Apache-2.0, Google LLC.
https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/v/0.10.18
FaceLandmarker task float16 version 1 includes BlazeFace, Face Mesh V2 and
Blendshape models: Apache-2.0, Google. Official model cards:
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/MediaPipe%20BlazeFace%20Model%20Card%20(Short%20Range).pdf
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/Model%20Card%20MediaPipe%20Face%20Mesh%20V2.pdf
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/Model%20Card%20Blendshape%20V2.pdf
See APACHE-2.0.txt. TFJS 4.22.0 is Apache-2.0; ml-matrix 6.12.1 is MIT.
Dependency versions and their distributed license files appear in DEPENDENCIES.json
and this directory. Bundle-specific notices are also in worker.js.LEGAL.txt.

Historical WebGazer source, assets, adaptations, notices, and tests remain in the
workspace, but WebGazer is not imported/loaded by this app. Those GPL notices
remain at /vendor/licenses/ and the workspace LICENSE remains GPL-3.0-or-later.
